description_target.ambiguity_notes: Input layer thickness, rectangle size, offset, and canvas aspect are discarded. A non-adjacent color may repeat and must remain repeated in the output order.
negative_constraints: do not preserve input layer thickness or offsets
do not sort or deduplicate the ordered layer colors
do not crop and resize the original pixels
do not assume the rectangles are centered or square
solution_steps: start with the full canvas and record its outer color
repeatedly replace the current box by the bounding box of cells with a different color
build an odd square whose Chebyshev-distance rings use the recorded colors outside to inside
description_target.target_text: Read the uniform colors of the nested filled rectangles from outside inward. For K layers, return a (2K-1)-square with one one-cell-thick concentric ring per color in the same order and the innermost color at the center.
